title: The Z-Machine Matter
author: Zack Urlocker
description:
In The Z-Machine Matter, you play the role of Johnny Dollar, an insurance detective called in to investigate the accidental death of German nuclear scientist Paul Panks at the secretive Blakely Laboratory in southern California.

This IntroComp entry is an Alpha Release of the opening two scenes of the game. You can think of it as a working prototype or preview version. It represents about 28% of the entire game.
